Privacy Policy

How Roubic Tree & Landscape LLC collects, uses, and protects the information you share when you request an estimate or browse {{global.domain}}.

Effective July 2026 We do not sell your data

Effective date: July 2026. Roubic Tree & Landscape LLC ("we," "us," "our") operates {{global.domain}}. This Privacy Policy explains what we collect, how we use it, and the rights you have over your information.

Information We Collect

When you submit our estimate or contact form, we collect the details you provide so we can respond and prepare an accurate quote:

  • Your name, phone number, email address, and service address (city and ZIP)
  • A description of the tree service you are inquiring about
  • Optional photos you choose to upload
  • Your consent to be contacted, given through the required checkbox on the form

We also collect anonymized usage data through Google Analytics and Google Search Console to understand how visitors use the site. We do not collect payment information on this website — payment is arranged after your in-person estimate.

How We Use Your Information

We use the information you share only to serve you and to improve the site:

  • To respond to your inquiry
  • To send your estimate and any follow-up communication
  • To improve the website using aggregate analytics only

We do not sell your information, and we do not share it with third-party advertisers.

Cookies

We use only essential cookies — for example, session cookies and anonymous analytics. Under Ohio law, no consent banner is required for these categories, so this site does not display a cookie pop-up. If we later add advertising or retargeting cookies, we will add a consent banner and update this policy accordingly.

Your Rights

You have the right to:

  • Request a copy of the information we hold about you
  • Ask us to delete your information, unless we are required to keep it by law
  • Opt out of marketing emails at any time

To exercise any of these rights, contact us using the details at the bottom of this page.

Data Retention

We keep information only as long as we need it:

  • Contact and estimate submissions: retained for three years
  • Analytics: anonymized and retained per Google's policies
  • Contracts and invoices: retained as required by the Ohio commercial code

Governing Law

This Privacy Policy is governed by the laws of the State of Ohio, with venue in Geauga County.

Contact Us

If you have questions about this Privacy Policy or wish to exercise your rights, contact us:

Roubic Tree & Landscape LLC
10840 Taylor May Rd, Auburn Township, OH 44023
Phone: {{global.phone}}
